audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says 'Dodge his E (Searing Charge) — if he pillars you into a wall it is a stun', wants.foe[1] says 'Land E pillar-into-wall to stun you against terrain', and whys[2] repeats 'his E pillar threatens a wall-stun'. Three strings describe one mechanic that does not exist.
audit.why: Searing Charge knocks up when ORNN collides with terrain, not when Malphite is pushed into it — Riot's text is 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him'. And the pillar is not part of E at all: it is left by Volcanic Rupture (Q). So the real combo is Q pillar first, then E into his own pillar for the shockwave. A player following the old advice watches the lane walls and stands next to a freshly-planted pillar, which is the single worst place to be.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture leaves the pillar; Searing Charge knocks up when Ornn hits terrain — including that pillar. Step away from a fresh pillar, not away from the wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Charge is his only mobility and its cooldown appears nowhere.
audit.why: Searing Charge is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 and it is the only movement in Ornn's kit outside his ultimate. Unstoppable Force reaches 1000 units. So the level 6 claim the page already makes — that Ornn cannot dodge it — is true, and now it has the number behind it: after he spends the charge there are twelve to fourteen seconds in which an immobile tank is standing in your R range.
audit.corrected: Searing Charge, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, is his only mobility — after he spends it he cannot leave your 1000-range R.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said 'Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it' — no numbers, and the description repeats the wall error.
audit.why: The three numbers that schedule this lane are Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 and Bellows Breath 12/11.5/11/10.5/10. The pillar's nine seconds is the specific window Malphite is allowed to step up in, and it was not written down.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7; Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12; Bellows Breath 12/11.5/11/10.5/10.

audit.why: The late-game plan is right and unusually well argued for a generated page: Living Forge lets him buy and upgrade without recalling, so a low-economy Malphite loses the item race, and the correct answer is to stop duelling and flank past him with R. No change needed.

edits.before: Ornn owns the opening outright — his W Bellows Breath shields him through your Q poke and his auto-attacks apply Brittle, so every time you step up to last-hit he can shove a free trade onto you while you still have no answer pre-W. Do not contest the wave; just soak XP at max range and use Q Seismic Shard purely to kite back, never to start a fight. Dodge his E (Searing Charge) — if he pillars you into a wall it is a stun, and a Brittle-empowered follow-up will chunk you hard.
edits.after: Ornn owns the opening outright — Bellows Breath (W, 12s at rank 1) shields him through your Q poke and leaves you Brittle, so every step-up to last-hit hands him a free trade while you have no answer pre-W. Do not contest the wave; soak XP at max range and use Seismic Shard to kite back, never to start a fight. The knock-up to dodge is not a wall-pin: Volcanic Rupture (Q) leaves a magma pillar, and Searing Charge (E) knocks up when Ornn hits terrain — his own pillar counts.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stabilize as W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam come online and Granite Shield lets you farm through his poke, but you still can't win a straight trade into his shield-and-Brittle pattern — stay reactive and stack armor. Level 6 is your moment: Unstoppable Force is the single button Ornn, an immobile tank with no dash, simply cannot dodge. Save R for a gank flank or to all-in when his E pillar is on cooldown, because outside that window you have nothing that beats him 1v1.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stabilize as Thunderclap and Ground Slam come online and Granite Shield lets you farm through his poke, but you still lose a straight trade to the shield-and-Brittle pattern — stay reactive and stack armour. Level 6 is your moment: Unstoppable Force is the one button an immobile Ornn cannot dodge. His combo needs a Volcanic Rupture pillar first, 9s at rank 1, so all-in or flank for a gank once that pillar is gone, and never stand beside one still standing.

notes: The packet's suspectName here ('Your Unstoppable Force' in spikes[1]) is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name with a leading possessive. The real error was mechanical and repeated three times: the page taught a wall-pin stun that Ornn does not have. Searing Charge knocks up when ORNN hits terrain, and the pillar it slams into comes from Volcanic Rupture, not from E. The corrected rule inverts the player's attention from lane walls to the pillar Ornn just planted. I did not assert anything about how Brittle works beyond naming it — Riot's text says only that enemies 'become Brittle', and the amplification numbers are not in the kit file.
